training.scope: Refitted on the existing exposed 304-file Java benchmark. Other languages and function-level predictions are not validated by this benchmark.
training.threshold_method: Minimum precision/recall margin then F1 rule on project-held-out predictions. Existing exposed labels; not an independent test.

measurement_policy.magnitude: Every maximum magnitude uses Qlty properties.actual: depth, count, cyclomatic complexity, or duplicated lines. Finding count, density, and coverage remain separate inputs.
measurement_policy.rationale: User-authorized migration to actual magnitudes throughout scoring and reports; preserves Rust threshold 5 and the cyclomatic-complexity fix.
